title: ANIMALS
overview: A tired TV worker pivots to work in the beauty industry, only to find romance and unexpected challenges with a charming CEO and a talented photographer.

title: Chimp Empire
overview: A vast community of chimpanzees thrives in a forest in Uganda, navigating complex social politics, family dynamics and dangerous territory disputes.

title: Night on Earth: Shot in the Dark
overview: This look behind the scenes shows how worldwide camera crews climbed, dived and froze to capture the documentary's groundbreaking night footage.

title: Our Great National Parks
overview: Narrated by former President Barack Obama, this stunning docuseries shines the spotlight on some of the planet's most spectacular national parks.

title: Our Living World
overview: This stunning nature series narrated by Cate Blanchett explores the intelligence, resourcefulness and interconnectedness of life on our planet.

title: Our Planet: Behind the Scenes
overview: Years spent recording footage of creatures from every corner of the globe is bound to produce a bit of drama. Here's a behind-the-scenes look.

title: Our Universe
overview: Witness the remarkable story of our universe over billions of years and its inextricable link to life on Earth in this sweeping documentary series.

title: Penguin Town
overview: In a picturesque South African town, an eclectic group of endangered penguins flock together to find mates, raise families and mix with the locals.

title: Piñata Masters!
overview: Which of the seven participating teams will be the Piñata Heroes? Their piñatas have to be colorful, creative and impress the picky jury: a group of kids!

overview: Anthony Morgan explores the extraordinary ways that animals hear and produce sound, and the crucial role sound plays in the lives of animals around the globe - from birth to surviving adulthood and finding a mate.

overview: With the help of the latest science and new camera technology, this exciting show reveals that our pets are hiding incredible superpowers and quirks of evolution.

overview: The Magic School Bus kids blast into orbit - and onto the International Space Station - only to find themselves on the run from a giant tardigrade.

overview: Little animals embark on big adventures across the U.S. in a dramatic nature series that explores their hidden worlds and epic survival stories.

overview: Top bakers and engineers team up to build edible creations that must taste delicious and survive intense engineering stress tests to win $100,000.

overview: From germs and emotions to social media and more, it's the science of your world explained in a way that's refreshingly relatable.

title: Is It Cake? Holiday
overview: Cake artists from past seasons return to craft tasty replicas of ice skates, nutcrackers and more in this holiday spin on the mind-bending baking contest.

title: Is It Cake? Halloween
overview: Cake or fake? Trick or treat? Skilled bakers whip up hyperrealistic Halloween cakes in this seasonal special edition of the hit competition series.

title: Mark Rober's CrunchLabs
overview: At CrunchLabs, Mark Rober transforms wild ideas into reality, blending engineering and outrageous fun for science adventures you'll never forget.

overview: Pint-sized scientist Ada Twist and her two best friends are asking big questions — and working together to discover the truth about everything!

title: StoryBots: Answer Time
overview: Got a question? The StoryBots have an answer! Join curious friends Beep, Boop, Bing, Bang and Bo on fun adventures to find facts for real kids like you.

overview: Count numbers, compare shapes, and find patterns with baby animals Franny, Bailey, Kip, Lulu, and Tilly as they use math and songs to solve problems.

overview: Based on the award-winning educational apps, the StoryBots are curious little creatures who live in the world beneath our screens and go on fun adventures to help answer kids' questions, like how night happens or why we need to brush our teeth.

title: Chico Bon Bon: Monkey with a Tool Belt
overview: Armed with tools and engineering smarts, monkey mechanic Chico Bon Bon and his Fix-It Force help the people of Blunderburg solve all of their problems.

title: Octonauts
overview: Follows an underwater exploring crew made up of stylized anthropomorphic animals, a team of eight adventurers who live in an undersea base, the Octopod, from where they go on undersea adventures with the help of a fleet of aquatic vehicles.

title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
overview: The Octonauts expand their exploration beyond the sea -- and onto land! With new rides and new friends, they'll protect any habitats and animals at risk.

title: The Magic School Bus
overview: An eccentric schoolteacher takes her class on wondrous educational field trips with the help of a magical school bus.

title: Wild Kratts
overview: The adventures of Chris and Martin Kratt as they encounter incredible wild animals, combining science education with fun and adventure as the duo travels to animal habitats around the globe.

overview: Rescued from poachers, an endangered baby pangolin embarks on a journey back to the wild with help from a devoted human guardian in this documentary.

overview: Veteran naturalist Sir David Attenborough tells the story of a remarkable group of gorillas, from his first encounter in the '70s to the present day.

overview: After a heartbreaking loss, a grandfather struggling to reclaim his passion for painting finds the inspiration to create again.

overview: Some of the world's most majestic birds display delightfully captivating mating rituals, from flashy dancing to flaunting their colorful feathers.

overview: With mesmerizing footage and time lapses of animators at work, this behind-the-scenes special captures the artistry of a unique tale years in the making.

title: The Crystal Calls - Making The Dark Crystal: Age of Resistance
overview: Go behind the scenes with stars, puppeteers and creators as they bring Jim Henson's magical world of Thra back to life in a sweeping fantasy series.

title: Emily's Wonder Lab
overview: Science-loving host Emily Calandrelli makes STEAM fun with activities, demonstrations and at-home experiments that'll make you think — and blow your mind!
